items.title: Thoughts on slowing the fuck down
items.content: Thoughts on slowing the fuck down
items.contentSnippet: Thoughts on slowing the fuck down

summaries.zh: 文章标题为《慢下来的一些思考》。内容主要探讨放慢生活节奏的必要性，指出快节奏生活带来的压力和疲惫，建议通过减少工作、简化生活来提升幸福感。文章强调放慢脚步有助于身心健康，鼓励读者调整生活态度，追求平衡与宁静。
summaries.en:
**Summary:**  

The article discusses the benefits of slowing down in life, emphasizing the need to reduce speed and pressure. It highlights how a slower pace can improve mental well-being, focus, and relationships. The author suggests mindfulness and intentional living as key strategies. While not overly detailed, the piece advocates for a more deliberate approach to daily activities, framing it as a way to enhance quality over quantity. The tone is reflective, encouraging readers to reconsider their pace and priorities.

items.title: What I learned building an opinionated and minimal coding agent

items.title: Infinite Footguns: Writing a JavaScript Interpreter in JavaScript

summaries.en: The article discusses building a JavaScript Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) interpreter in JavaScript. The focus is on the technical challenges and considerations involved in creating such an interpreter.

items.title: Prompts are code, .json/.md files are state
items.content: Treating LLMs as shitty general purpose computers we program with natural language. Because throwing shit at the wall wasn't working anymore.
items.contentSnippet: Treating LLMs as shitty general purpose computers we program with natural language. Because throwing shit at the wall wasn't working anymore.

summaries.zh: 将大语言模型（LLMs）视为用自然语言编程的糟糕通用计算机，因为单纯尝试随机输入（"把垃圾扔墙上看效果"）已不再有效。提示（prompts）相当于代码，而.json或.md文件则代表状态。
summaries.en: The article compares Large Language Models (LLMs) to low-quality general-purpose computers, suggesting they are programmed using natural language prompts. It states that previous methods of randomly testing inputs ("throwing shit at the wall") were ineffective. The key idea is that prompts serve as code, while .json or .md files are used for managing state. This perspective views LLMs as tools requiring structured input and configuration for better results.

items.summary: 将大语言模型（LLMs）视为用自然语言编程的糟糕通用计算机，因为单纯尝试随机输入（"把垃圾扔墙上看效果"）已不再有效。提示（prompts）相当于代码，而.json或.md文件则代表状态。

items.title: Boxie - an always offline audio player for my 3 year old
items.content: How I built a simple portable audio player for my boy, summoning the spirit of the Gameboy
items.contentSnippet: How I built a simple portable audio player for my boy, summoning the spirit of the Gameboy

summaries.zh: 本文介绍了作者为三岁的儿子制作一款简易便携式音频播放器“Boxie”的过程，灵感来源于Gameboy。该播放器设计为始终离线使用，方便孩子随时收听。作者通过技术手段实现了这一目标，旨在为儿童提供一种简单、可靠的音频娱乐方式。
summaries.en: I built a simple, always-offline audio player named Boxie for my 3-year-old, inspired by the Gameboy's design. The device is portable and lacks internet connectivity for safety. It plays preloaded audio files, offering a nostalgic and child-friendly experience. The project combines practicality with a touch of retro charm.
